notes: "hợp với người đã nuôi vài loại cá và muốn thử cá sọc vằn bản địa": the page and card never say who the fish suits or that it needs prior experience. Difficulty 4/8 alone doesn't support this. "bản địa" is also the summary's own framing.

"cần tìm hiểu thêm trước khi mua" and "kiểm tra vây lưng ... trước khi mua": buying advice the page does not give. The page only lists traits that tell A. iridescens from A. longipinnis. It gives no advice on buying.

"nên thông tin về cách nuôi còn ít": the page never says care information is scarce. It only says the species was described in 2007 and that the fish on sale come from Peru. The summary invents this conclusion and presents it as following from those two facts.

"hợp với người muốn nuôi cá dao mà không cần con quá lớn": the page says only that the fish is small for a knifefish (about 20 cm). It doesn't say who the species suits, so this suitability claim is a weak inference.

"Chỉ cho ăn thức ăn không liên quan đến tảo ... nên bổ sung thức ăn thực vật hoặc tảo": the page only describes the wild diet ("Ngoài tự nhiên, cá ăn tảo bám..."). It gives no aquarium feeding advice. The mistake and its fix are advice the page doesn't give.
"10–15 cm" is neither the card's adult size (20 cm) nor its minimum tank (100 cm)
"chưa ai cho sinh sản được trong bể" states as certain what the page hedges: "Đến nay có lẽ chưa ai cho loài này sinh sản được trong bể" ("có lẽ" = probably). The hedge was dropped.

"cá hay bị bán trong tình trạng gầy và rất khó phục hồi": the page says this about fish of the family Gastromyzontidae in general, not about Annamia normani. It never says Annamia belongs to that family. The page also says only "khó phục hồi", so "rất" strengthens it. The summary turns a general remark into a certainty about this species and uses it as the hardest part of keeping it.
"10 cm" is not the card's adult size (50 cm)
"15 cm" is not the card's minimum tank (180 cm)

Third mistake: "Cho ăn ... dùng lâu dài cá bảy màu, cá vàng nhỏ làm mồi; nên cho dải thịt cá trắng, tôm nguyên con, giun đất". The page also says "Cá mồi là thức ăn bắt buộc phải có", so the fix to swap feeder fish for strips, shrimp and worms contradicts it. The page only calls long-term feeder fish of little benefit, and the summary turns that hedge into a firm mistake.

"1–2 bữa mỗi tuần" is given without saying it applies only to adult fish. The page says adults don't need daily feeding, and the other section says newly imported fish are hard to feed at first, so the schedule is stated too broadly.
"hợp với người nuôi có kinh nghiệm, có bể lớn": the page and card give no difficulty rating, experience requirement or tank size/advice, so this suitability claim is not supported by the page.
"30 cm" is neither the card's adult size (none) nor its minimum tank (none)

Third mistake: "Để cá bố mẹ trong bể đẻ sau khi đẻ thì trứng bị ăn" states as certain that the eggs get eaten. The page hedges: parents "nhiều khả năng sẽ ăn trứng nếu có dịp" (likely to eat eggs if given the chance).

"hợp với người đã nuôi betta hoang dã": the page never says this fish suits keepers who already have wild bettas or experience with them. The card's difficulty is only medium (4/8), so this audience claim is unsupported.

"hợp với người đã nuôi được vài loài cá mê cung": the page never says the species suits keepers who already have labyrinth-fish experience. This is an invented claim about who it suits. The page only says it is unsuited to a standard community tank and is shy.
"hợp với người đã nuôi betta hoang dã": the page never says the species needs an experienced or wild-betta keeper. The card rates it 4/8, which is medium, so this suitability claim is invented.

"hợp với người đã quen nuôi cá nhỏ": the page never says the species suits experienced small-fish keepers. It only says to keep it in a species-only tank and gives difficulty 4/8. The experience requirement is invented.

"thì cá khó sống tốt": the page only says the species is "không phải là cá lý tưởng cho bể cộng đồng" (not ideal). It says nothing about the fish doing poorly or struggling to survive, so the hedge became a stronger claim.
"15 cm" is not the card's adult size (22,5 cm)
Summary says "Cần ... nền cát" as a requirement, but the page only hedges: gravel is usable and sand is "có lẽ là lựa chọn tốt hơn" (probably better). The hedge became a certainty.
"trùn chỉ muỗi lắc": the page lists "ấu trùng muỗi lắc (chironomid)". "Trùn chỉ" (tubifex worms) is a different food the page never mentions, so this is a garbled or invented food item.
"thì ảnh hưởng tuổi thọ và sức khỏe": the page says long-term freshwater or full seawater "có thể ảnh hưởng" (may affect) lifespan and health. The summary turns that hedge into a certainty.
"thì cá tích mỡ": the page says the fat "có thể gây tích mỡ thừa" (may cause excess fat build-up). The summary states it as certain.

"thì cá sẽ đánh nhau": the page says only that the fish "có thể hung hăng" (may be aggressive) toward relatives or similar-looking fish and is not sociable with its own kind. The summary states fighting as certain.
"5–8 cm" is neither the card's adult size (13,5 cm) nor its minimum tank (120 cm)
"rất khó cứu": the page says the emaciated state is "khá khó cứu" (fairly hard to save). The summary strengthens this to "very hard", which overstates the page's hedge.

"hợp người đã quen cá ăn mồi động vật": the page never says the species suits keepers with experience of carnivorous fish. It calls the fish "dễ nuôi trong bể nhà", and the card difficulty is 2/8 (easy). The suitability claim is unsupported and leans against the easy rating.
"khó nhất là giữ nước mát": the page never says keeping water cool is hard. It only gives the 10–22 °C range, so this hardest point is the summary's own inference.
"hợp với người đã quen nuôi cá săn mồi": the page does not say the species suits experienced keepers of predatory fish. It only says the fish is an obligate predator and gives no audience advice.
"30 cm" is neither the card's adult size (20 cm) nor its minimum tank (120 cm)

"thì cá tích mỡ, có thể thoái hóa nội tạng": the page hedges both effects ("lâu dần có thể làm cá tích mỡ thừa, thậm chí gây thoái hóa nội tạng"). The summary states fat build-up as certain and drops "lâu dần".
"dễ mang ký sinh trùng, mầm bệnh": the page says feeder fish "có thể mang" parasites or pathogens. "Dễ" makes that hedge stronger.
"ưu tiên mồi tươi": the page doesn't say to prefer fresh or live prey. It says most fish take dead food easily.
"thức ăn khô làm món chính thì cá thiếu chất": the page only says dry food must never be the staple. It gives no reason, so the nutrient-deficiency consequence is invented.
"hợp với người đã quen nuôi cá săn mồi": the page and card give no experience level or difficulty, so this suitability claim isn't supported.

"hợp với người đã nuôi cá đẻ con vùng cao Mexico": the page never says this species suits keepers with prior experience of Mexican highland livebearers. The card rates difficulty as medium, and the page names no target keeper, so this suitability claim is invented.

"cá đực đánh nhau liên tục" and "trồng dày cây": the page only says cover makes males fight less ("bớt đánh nhau") and that males are territorial but can live together. It never says males fight constantly, and it never asks for dense planting. This turns a hedge into a certainty and adds advice the page doesn't give.

"cũng ít dinh dưỡng": the page says feeder fish are usually not nutritious only "nếu không nuôi vỗ kỹ từ trước" (if not conditioned beforehand). The summary drops that condition and states it as a certainty.
"dễ mang ký sinh trùng, mầm bệnh": the page says feeder fish "có nguy cơ" (carry a risk of) bringing in parasites or pathogens. "Dễ" (easily/likely) makes the hedge stronger.
"Thả chung các loài Copadichromis khác sẽ bị lai" turns the page's hedge ("có thể lai với nhau", they may hybridise) into a certainty.
"dễ lai với Copadichromis khác" in the summary overstates the page's "có thể lai" (may hybridise). The page doesn't say they hybridise easily.

"Dùng lọc đáy ... thì cá dễ rụng râu": the page only says not to use an undergravel filter and, separately, that poor conditions may cause barbel loss. It never links the undergravel filter to barbel loss.
"hợp người đã nuôi vài bể": the page says nothing about keeper experience. This only loosely follows from the card's medium difficulty and is an unsupported suitability claim.

"thì cá nhút nhát, con yếu bị bắt nạt liên tục": the page hedges this. It says that with one or a few fish they "có thể trở nên nhút nhát", and that weaker fish "có thể bị bắt nạt liên tục". The summary states both as certain.
"Cho ăn nhiều đạm dễ làm cá tích mỡ, thoái hóa nội tạng": the page says this only "có thể" happens, and only with frequent, long-term feeding. The summary turns that hedge into a likely outcome.
"chưa từng được cho sinh sản trong bể": the page hedges this with "người ta cho rằng loài này chưa từng được cho sinh sản trong bể" (it is only believed so). The summary states it as a certainty.

Mistake 2 fix: "Nên chọn bạn bể khỏe hơn" is advice the page doesn't give. The page only warns that big adults may bully slow or shy tank mates. It also says many fish suit as tank mates (cyprinids, loaches, cichlids, catfish, characins). It never says to pick tank mates that are stronger.

"lọc mạnh nhưng dòng chảy yếu": the page recommends an external canister filter, a sump, or both, to keep the water stable. It never calls for strong filtration, and it says the tank should not have strong flow. "lọc mạnh" is an unsupported embellishment.

"người đã có kinh nghiệm cichlid Tanganyika": the page does not say the species suits keepers with Tanganyika cichlid experience. It only says not to add the fish to an unstable tank and that beginners should not strip eggs. This specific suitability claim is invented.

Mistake 3: "Chỉ cho ăn thức ăn nổi hoặc thức ăn khô thì gần như vô ích vì cá hiếm lên mặt nước" is wrong about dry food. The page says only floating food is "gần như vô ích". It says the fish accept medium-sized dry food but shouldn't be fed only that. The summary extends "vô ích" to all dry food, which the page doesn't say.
"Nuôi 2–4 con chung": the page doesn't give the range 2–4. It says to keep one fish or a group of 5 or more. The number is worked out from the text, so it counts as not written.

"hợp với người đã có tay nghề": the page never says the species suits experienced keepers. It says only that it suits public display tanks or extra-large home tanks. The card rates difficulty 4/8, which is medium.

"Khó nhất là dựng bể kiểu suối nước đen": the page never says a blackwater or forest-stream tank is hard to set up. It only says the fish do well in a densely planted tank or a biotope tank, so this difficulty claim is unsupported.

"nước gần như sạch tinh và giàu oxy": the page only hedges that the fish "nhiều khả năng ưa nước giàu oxy hòa tan và dòng chảy vừa phải". The summary states high oxygen as a firm requirement, so a hedge became a certainty.
"15 cm" is neither the card's adult size (250 cm) nor its minimum tank (none)
"Hợp với người đã nuôi vài năm": the page never says the fish suits keepers with a few years of experience. The card only gives difficulty 4/8 (medium), so this is an invented claim.
"rất dữ với cá trông giống nó": the page hedges with "có thể rất hung dữ" and adds "Có con dữ hơn con khác". The summary states it as a certainty.
"150 × 60 × 60 cm": the card gives no minimum tank
"150 × 60 × 60 cm": the card gives no minimum tank

Mistake 1 fix, "nên chỉ mua khi đã có sẵn bể dài ít nhất 200 cm": the page says juveniles are "rất không nên mua" and that, except in very special cases, the fish shouldn't be kept in a home tank. The fix turns that into permission to buy once you have a 200 cm tank. The page says only the largest home tanks or public display tanks suit the fish, so it doesn't say a 200 cm tank is enough.

Third mistake: "Cho ăn đơn điệu một loại... nên cho ăn đa dạng theo hướng đó" is advice the page doesn't give. The page only records the wild diet (giáp xác sống ở đáy, côn trùng, thân mềm). It says nothing about aquarium feeding or about variety being a mistake.

"hợp với người đã có kinh nghiệm cơ bản": the page doesn't say the fish needs an experienced keeper. The card rates it 3/8 (easy), so this suitability claim is unsupported and fits poorly with that rating.
"Nuôi lẻ vài con khiến cá nhút nhát": the page hedges this. It says fewer than six "có thể nhút nhát hơn" (may be shier), and the summary turns that into a certainty.

"để cá lên màu và bạo dạn hơn": the page says only that six or more lets you see them "đẹp nhất" (at their best). It says nothing about colouring up ("lên màu"), and "bạo dạn hơn" is stated more firmly than the page's hedge.
"5 cm" is neither the card's adult size (5,5 cm) nor its minimum tank (45 cm)

Mistake 3 says "chỉ lau mặt kính dùng để ngắm" as a firm rule. The page hedges: "có lẽ chỉ trừ mặt kính dùng để ngắm" ("probably except"). The summary turns that hedge into a certainty and adds a cleaning instruction the page doesn't give.

"Hợp với người đã nuôi cá đáy một thời gian": the page doesn't say it needs experienced keepers. It says "nuôi không quá khó" and calls the fish common among hobbyists, so this suitability claim is unsupported and leans against the page.
"nên hỏi rõ nguồn gốc cá trước khi mua": the page gives no advice to ask sellers about origin. This is added advice.
"120 × 60 × 60 cm": the card gives no minimum tank

"con đực không khoe màu": the page says males show their best colour when kept with others of their kind ("chịu khoe màu đẹp nhất"). It does not say a male kept in a small group shows no colour. The summary turns a "best colour" claim into an absolute one.
"làm chúng bị rối": the page says fast, large rainbowfish "có thể" (may) upset smaller or slow fish. The summary drops the hedge and states it as certain.
"Cần bể dài từ 45 cm, nền cát mềm": the page hedges this. It says "Nhiều khả năng cá thích nền cát mềm" and "nền cát mềm có lẽ hợp với chúng nhất". The summary turns that into a requirement ("Cần").

"ghép với loài giữ lãnh thổ gắt như Schistura" is presented as a flat mistake. The page hedges this: such relatives are too territorial or aggressive, but "nếu bể đủ lớn thì nuôi chung vẫn có thể ổn". The hedge became a certainty.

"Hợp với người đã quen giữ bể nước chảy" is not on the page. The page says "Loài này không khó nuôi nếu bể đúng điều kiện" and never says it needs an experienced keeper. This invents a suitability claim.

"thức ăn khô chỉ nên là phần phụ": the page only says not to feed dry food alone ("không nên chỉ cho ăn mỗi loại này") and that fish accept it. It never says dry food should be only a minor part of the diet, so this advice is invented.
"cá hiền và thích sống theo nhóm": the page hedges this with "có vẻ thích sống theo nhóm" (seems to like living in groups). The summary states it as a certainty.

"hợp với người đã có chút kinh nghiệm": the page never says who the species suits. The card difficulty is 3/8 (easy), so this suitability claim is unsupported and conflicts with the easy rating the summary itself gives.

"nên bố trí cả hai vùng" and "dựng được dòng chảy phù hợp theo từng cỡ cá": the page only describes wild habitat preferences. It gives no aquarium advice to build separate fast-flow and deep slow-flow zones, or that this is the hardest part of keeping the fish.

The fix "nên chỉ ghép với cá lớn hoặc nuôi riêng" gives tank-mate advice the page doesn't give. The page says nothing about compatible tank mates, and it says the fish eats fish. Pairing it with large fish is not supported.
"chưa hợp với người mới; chỉ nên cân nhắc nếu đã quen nuôi cá dao Nam Mỹ": the page gives no suitability advice and the card has no difficulty, so this is invented advice.

"thông tin về loài này còn rất ít" and "mới có một cá thể được nhập về": the page only says one specimen "đã" been imported from Peru. It does not say information is scarce or that only one has ever been imported, so this overstates the page.
"25–30 cm" is neither the card's adult size (45 cm) nor its minimum tank (none)

"Để bể ấm quanh năm làm cá giảm tuổi thọ": the page hedges this ("nhiều khả năng sẽ giảm tuổi thọ", i.e. likely). The mistake states it as a certainty. The advice "nên nuôi không sưởi" is also stated flatly, though the page limits it to "ở nhiều nước, hoặc trong những ngôi nhà cách nhiệt tốt".

"Nuôi chung với các loài Oryzias khác dễ bị lai": the page says only that they "có thể lai với nhau" (can interbreed), shown in lab experiments. "Dễ bị lai" (readily hybridise) is stronger than the page.
"Thả chung vào bể cộng đồng thì cá không hợp điều kiện": the page says the fish are unsuited to "nhiều bể cộng đồng" (many community tanks). The summary makes this apply to all of them.

"hợp với người đã nuôi cá vài năm": the page never says the species needs an experienced keeper or any number of years. The card rates difficulty 4/8 (medium), so this suitability claim and the "vài năm" figure are invented.

"hợp với người đã nuôi cá cỡ vừa": the page never says the species suits keepers who have kept medium-sized fish. It gives only difficulty 4/8 and says to house it with larger tank mates. This audience claim is invented.

Fix in mistake 2, "nhặt các ổ trứng trong suốt dán trong bể": the page never advises removing egg clutches or controlling snail numbers. It only describes the clutches, so this is advice the page doesn't give.
Fix in mistake 1, "xử lý trong nhà": the page only says never to release ornamental snails into the environment. It gives no advice on disposing of them at home.

"và cho ăn sau khi tắt đèn": the page only says a newly introduced fish "có thể chỉ chịu ăn sau khi tắt đèn", so this applies to the first days after release. The summary makes it a general feeding rule, so a hedge on the page has become a certainty.

"hợp với người đã nuôi cá một thời gian": the page never says the species suits experienced keepers. It calls the fish "dễ thích nghi" and "cực kỳ hiền", and says it suits a large community tank. The "experienced keeper" audience is invented.

"hợp với người nuôi cichlid Nam Mỹ có kinh nghiệm": the page never says the fish needs an experienced keeper. This is an unsupported claim about who it suits, and it clashes with the card's difficulty of 3/8 (easy), which the summary itself repeats.

"yếu thế khi tranh ăn": the page only says the fish is likely at a disadvantage when competing with other fish ("cạnh tranh với cá khác"). It does not say the competition is over food, so the summary adds a claim the page doesn't make.

The fix "nên chọn bạn cùng bể hiền và nhỏ" gives tank-mate advice the page doesn't give. The page only says the fish is likely weak when competing with other fish. It never says to choose gentle or small tank mates.
"hợp người đã quen chăm cá nhỏ" says who the fish suits, but the page says nothing about keeper experience or about having kept small fish before. The card only gives difficulty 4/8 (medium).
"15 cm" is not the card's adult size (14 cm)
"hợp với người có bể lớn": the page and card say nothing about tank size or who the fish suits. This is an inference from adult size, not stated on the page.

"Đừng chọn bể theo kích thước cá con mới nhập; hãy tính bể cho con trưởng thành 30 cm": the page gives no tank-sizing advice, so this mistake and fix are not on the page. The summary itself says the page gives no tank figures.
"6-8 cm" is not the card's adult size (30 cm)

"nên dễ quan sát hơn nhiều loài cùng giống": the page doesn't compare how easy it is to observe this species with other Synodontis. It only says the fish is active and swims in the daytime. The comparison is an added claim.
"Để cá bố mẹ ở lại bể đẻ thì trứng bị ăn": the page hedges this with "nhiều khả năng sẽ ăn trứng nếu có dịp" (likely, if given the chance). The summary states it as a certainty.

"hợp người mới lên cichlid Trung Mỹ": the page never says the species suits beginners or people new to Central American cichlids. The card gives difficulty 4/8, which is medium, so this audience claim is unsupported and leans toward "easy".
"7–9 cm" is not the card's adult size (25 cm)
"7–9 cm" is not the card's adult size (25 cm)

Mistake 2: "nên dùng bể dài từ 90 cm trở lên" is given as the fix for male aggression. The page gives 90 cm only as the minimum tank size. It never says a larger tank, or avoiding a cramped one, reduces fighting between males. It also never warns against keeping several males in a "bể chật". This is advice the page doesn't give.

Summary: "hợp với người mới lẫn người chơi lâu năm" turns a hedge into a certainty. The page says "người mới chơi nên cân nhắc tính khí của nó trước khi nuôi". Nothing on the page says it suits long-time keepers.

"ánh sáng yếu và cây rậm" is listed as a need ("Cần"). The page only says the species "có vẻ hợp nhất với ánh sáng khá yếu", and it says "Bày trí bể không quá quan trọng". A hedge became a requirement.
"Để đèn quá sáng thì cá không hợp": the page only says the fish seem to suit fairly dim light best ("có vẻ hợp nhất"). It never says bright light is unsuitable. This turns a hedge into a certainty.
"lại nhạy với chất bẩn hữu cơ và thay đổi đột ngột của nước": the page hedges this with "Loài này có thể nhạy cảm" (may be sensitive). The summary states it as a certainty.
